professionalSummary: Analytics engineer with three years of experience building and maintaining transformation models in a marketing data warehouse, managing data quality checks, coordinating model releases, and mentoring analysts. 90+ models delivered under the standard framework. 11 analysts mentored and reviewed.  Daily data quality resolution and comprehensive documentation of model limitations.  Coordinated releases with lead approval.
experienceHighlights: Built and maintained 90+ transformation models under the modelling framework's standard, each submitted via a merge request in my name.  Reviewed marketing analysts' model contributions as one of two reviewers and mentored 11 analysts through onboarding sessions.  Ran daily data quality checks and resolved failures per the data quality procedure, logging each resolution.  Coordinated model releases via a release checklist, with approval from the analytics engineering lead and documented my responsibility boundaries.  Documented each model's limitations and hand‑over conditions in its documentation page.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Two merge requests with review records, onboarding attendance log with analysts' first contributions, one week of data quality failure log, and a release checklist with approval – all referenced in the repository.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s experience and responsibilities in building and maintaining transformation models, reviewing analyst contributions, running data quality checks, coordinating releases, and documenting model limitations.  They do not provide evidence of the candidate’s interpersonal traits or the broader organizational context.  Interview notes are subjective and are treated as interview signals.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Analytics Engineer, Marketing Data Warehouse role.

evidence.text: Analytics engineer on the marketing data warehouse of a consumer software company for three years, building and maintaining the warehouse's transformation models under the modelling framework's standard; about ninety models in the period, each on a merge request in my name.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of model building and maintenance

evidence.text: Reviewed the marketing analysts' model contributions as one of the team's two reviewers and mentored the analysts new to the framework through the onboarding sessions; the review records and the onboarding attendance for eleven analysts are in the repository, with the analysts' first merged contributions logged against their onboarding.
Ran the data quality checks each day and resolved their failures under the data quality procedure, with the failure log recording each resolution.
evidence.notes: Daily data quality checks and resolution

evidence.text: Coordinated model releases through the release checklist; the release approval was the analytics engineering lead's, recorded on the checklist together with which checks were mine.
Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each model in its documentation page.
